story.title: Track and filter tasks
acceptanceCriteria: A user can add tasks and see them in the list
A user can mark a task complete
The Active and Completed filters show only matching tasks

scenes.title: Adding tasks
scenes.narration: This is TodoMVC, a small task list. To meet the first acceptance criterion, we type a task into the box at the top and press Enter, then add two more. Each one appears in the list straight away.

scenes.title: Completing a task
scenes.narration: For the second criterion, ticking the checkbox next to a task marks it complete. It's struck through, and the counter at the bottom now says two items are left.

scenes.title: Filtering
scenes.narration: Finally, the filters. Active shows only the tasks still to do, Completed shows only the finished one, and All brings everything back. That covers all three acceptance criteria.
